Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Our opening proposal is a $45 million class fund, with payments distributed automatically to all identified class members. We propose $9 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses, subject to court approval, with no clear-sailing agreement and any amount not awarded added to the class fund. The proposal reflects the substantial value of the claims while avoiding the delay and risk of continued litigation.

This provides a $30 million total cash commitment and avoids a claims process.

declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The parties negotiated over five rounds. Hargrove Lane opened with a $45 million class fund and $9 million in fees and expenses; Brightline countered with a $25 million fund and $5 million in fees and expenses. The parties then moved through successive proposals, ultimately reaching Brightline’s $33 million class-fund and $5 million fee proposal, which Hargrove Lane accepted. The accepted terms provide for automatic payments to identified class members, no clear-sailing agreement, and any fee amount not awarded by the court to be added to the class fund. Fees were discussed alongside class relief from the first round; they were not reserved until after class relief had been agreed. The transcript reflects the parties’ proposals and movements, and the requested fee remains subject to the court’s independent review.
